notes: Draft configuration: Historical Dundrod Road main course with the northern dip chicane, inward western notch, eastern straight and short southern return. The independently mapped 2018 raceway branches form an exact closed node-connected circuit; the allowed shared timing point is 0.6 m from this route. The eastern inner hairpin, full southern extension and the longer southwestern alternate loop are excluded because they change the listed course identity. A small access spur is not included in the closed racing lap. The source measures 840.9 m, 98.1 m shorter than the catalogue scalar of 939 m; this unresolved distance difference is retained and no coordinates or extra branches are added to force agreement. The primary experience operator identifies the seven-corner car layout at this venue; the archive layout facts support the historical branch choice, not coordinates. This is a historical draft centerline, not a validated 939 m timing lap. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 840.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 27 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
